name: solidity-hashlock-escrow
title: Hashlock token escrow
description: ERC20 hash-locked transfers with SHA-256 preimages, recipient-only redemption and expiry refunds.
assumptions: Contract IDs are globally unique. Recipient must redeem before expiry; sender may refund at or after expiry. Secret is revealed publicly on redemption. Cross-chain safety, censorship and finality must be handled outside the contract.
